state.regression: J07 (surfaces built on open, kept two minutes) measured in the nested harness: a cheatsheet built on open maps in about 100 ms but paints nothing for 8 s or more, with the shell's main thread at 99-100% CPU throughout; the old persistent window paints in 1.3 s and a warm reopen in 1 s. Of seven variants only one avoids it: asking for keyboard focus 150 ms after the window is visible (commit 2dcae7a61 of 2026-07-30 records the same slowness for a per-open cheatsheet that asked for focus while mapping).
state.mechanism: services/GlobalFocusGrab.qml: the shared HyprlandFocusGrab's windows binding calls hasActive(w.contentItem), which walks every descendant item reading activeFocus and children. A binding depends on every property it reads, so while a 5000-item window is built every added child re-runs the binding and every run walks the whole tree: quadratic work on the main thread. hasActive has one caller, that binding, always with a window's contentItem; a window's contentItem is the root focus scope, so its activeFocus alone is true exactly when any item in the window has active focus. J07 has a confirming batch queued (evaluation and visit counts, a cheap-walk copy, a no-grab copy).
state.scope: GlobalFocusGrab.qml is outside J07's file list; no running worker touches it. Every dismissable surface (sidebars, launchpad, cheatsheet, search) goes through this grab.

J07_focus_grab_fix.instructions: How should the cold-cheatsheet storm be fixed?

criteria.fix_grab_binding: Let J07 change the binding to read w.contentItem.activeFocus (and drop the walk), with a test that the grab's window list is unchanged for focus inside and outside each dismissable surface, and the cold cheatsheet painting within a second. Strongest case: removes the quadratic cause for every surface built on open, one line in one service, its only caller. Cost: a shared service changes inside J07's job, so every grab-using surface needs the dismiss check.
criteria.workaround_in_cheatsheet: J07 asks for keyboard focus after the cheatsheet's first frame, inside Cheatsheet.qml only, and the service line becomes a separate item. Strongest case: stays inside J07's files. Cost: keeps the quadratic binding for every other surface built on open (launchpad, sidebars, search), and a timing delay hides the cause.
criteria.need_more_facts: Wait for J07's confirming batch before deciding.
